messages:
maya: rolling out release v2 -> traffic swap to canary (10%) in us-west-2
maya: seeing 502/503s from encoder-service canary pods, some crashloops
raj: looking at logs now, encoder init OOMKilled on a few pods, stack shows native allocator failure
kevin: HPA config for encoder canary looks wrong: minReplicas=0 in the canary HPA (likely scaled to zero during drain)
infra-bot: started node drain on ip-10-0-3-45 for maintenance (cordon + evict)
incident-bot: paging oncall @emma_oncall for channel #incidents (reason: canary 5xx spike)
emma_oncall: oncall here, reading thread — is there customer impact reported?
maya: yes, about ~4% of requests in us-west returned 5xx, a few integrations reported errors (no confirmed data loss)
emma_oncall: ok. two immediate options: flip feature flag to stop routing to v2, or rollback the deployment. which is fastest?
raj: flip flag is fastest if it exists. key is release/v2-route in LaunchDarkly. rollback is reliable too if we want to fully revert code path.
kevin: executing kill-switch: `ldctl set --key release/v2-route --env prod false`
kevin: output: {"status":"ok","changed":true}
maya: traffic shifting back to v1, monitoring metrics now
maya: 5xxs dropping but canary encoder pods still in CrashLoopBackOff on some nodes
kevin: recommendation: rollback deployment to previous stable revision while we fix HPA/probe config
emma_oncall: agree. call rollback and restore traffic. I'll coordinate comms.
raj: running: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/encoder --to-revision=17`
raj: console: deployment.apps/encoder "encoder" rolled back
infra-bot: node drain completed for ip-10-0-3-45, node uncordoned
maya: after rollback, request errors returned to baseline; latency normalizing
emma_oncall: customer impact summary: ~23 client sessions saw failures during the window (~20m). No persisted state corruption reported. Support notified.
incident-bot: Incident created INC-20260317-42, severity S2. Pager cleared.
kevin: follow-ups: bump hpa.minReplicas to 2 for encoder, lengthen readinessProbe timeout, increase memory limit for encoder init
raj: created PR #4987 updating HPA minReplicas=2 and probe.timeoutSeconds=15, added note about canary HPA inheritance
maya: agree on changes, and freeze further canaries until PR lands and we validate on staging
emma_oncall: I'll own communication and postmortem. Please add logs + crash traces to the ticket.
maya: TL;DR: canary crashed because node drain + HPA min=0 + strict readiness -> 0 pods or crashloops; feature-flag kill-switch + rollback mitigated customer impact. Postmortem in INC-20260317-42 will capture details.
